scope_note: A new section in the coverage-completion round the repository owner authorised on 2026-09-14 (audits/coverage/2026-09-14/STUDY-GUIDE-COVERAGE-COMPLETION-PLAN.json); no earlier audit binds it. Two planned records contradict their authority and were replaced before freezing: MA-CS-QUANTITY-II-III (which frames the 30-day cap as applying to opioid prescriptions and the 90-day category by drug, and links an unofficial copy) by MA-CS-SINGLE-FILLING-SUPPLY-CEILING and MA-POLICY-2024-05-QUANTITY-LIMITS; and FED-OUD-OTP (which adds a qualifier current 21 CFR 1306.07(d) lacks and rests partly on a superseded DEA letter) by FED-NARCOTIC-MAINTENANCE-DETOX-ROUTES. Added for in-scope law no record carried: FED-CS-RX-DATED-SIGNED-CONTENTS (21 CFR 1306.05(a)), FED-CII-EARLIEST-FILL-DATE-PHARMACIST (21 CFR 1306.14(e)) and MA-CII-MULTIPLE-RX-ISSUANCE-DATE (the Massachusetts guidance that treats the do-not-fill-before date as the date of issuance for M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 23); the existing FED-CII-SIGNED-PRESCRIPTION and MA-CII-VALIDITY-30D were added so the fax default and the Massachusetts validity window are grounded. Scope gate: the two MEDIUM topic neighbours are the replaced records; the LOW neighbours are emergency-oral, Schedule II partial-fill, Schedule III-V refill and oral follow-up rules, each another section's declared subject. MA-Q-0024, MA-Q-0164 and MA-Q-0434 stay unmapped because their keys rest on law outside this scope.
